# Aggrepoxy Floor Coatings

> Aggrepoxy Floor Coatings is a family-owned concrete floor coating contractor serving homeowners and businesses across Los Angeles County, Orange County and the Inland Empire in Southern California, with an original commercial operation in Chicago. Services include flake, quartz, metallic and solid color epoxy and polyaspartic floors for garages, driveways, patios and pool decks; polished and sealed concrete; and commercial and industrial floor systems. Free on-site estimates, one-day residential installs, and a 10-year limited warranty.

## Key facts

- Business name: Aggrepoxy Floor Coatings (Aggrepoxy Floor Coatings LLC)
- Type: Concrete floor coating contractor (epoxy, polyaspartic, metallic epoxy, polished concrete)
- Service areas: Los Angeles County, Orange County and the Inland Empire (Riverside and San Bernardino counties), California; Chicago and the Chicagoland suburbs, Illinois
- Southern California: (213) 971-5868, jordan@aggrepoxy.com
- Chicago: (630) 632-4701, jim@aggrepoxy.com
- General email: floors@aggrepoxy.com
- Website: https://aggrepoxy.com
- Family-owned. The Chicago operation has been coating floors since 2016 and has coated more than 1,000,000 square feet, including car dealerships and food manufacturing plants. The Southern California branch serves LA, Orange County and the Inland Empire.
- Estimates: free, in-person, about 20 minutes. Proposals are sent within a few hours. Aggrepoxy does not quote over the phone or from photos.
- Residential installs: most garages are completed in one day.
- Cure: light foot traffic after about 24 hours, vehicles after 48 hours.
- Warranty: 10-year limited warranty on product and workmanship.
- Financing: available through Acorn Finance.
- Topcoat: UV-stable polyaspartic that resists yellowing and hot tire pickup.

## Services

- [Garage floor coatings](https://aggrepoxy.com/services/garage-floors.html): AGX Precision System. A 3-part system: epoxy base coat, full broadcast of decorative flake or quartz, and a UV-stable polyaspartic topcoat. Also used for driveways, patios, walkways, stairs and pool decks.
- Metallic epoxy floors: custom high-gloss metallic epoxy with a marbled, three-dimensional look for garages, showrooms, retail spaces and home interiors.
- Solid color epoxy floors: clean, single-color epoxy coatings for garages, workshops, warehouses and commercial spaces.
- [Polished and sealed concrete](https://aggrepoxy.com/services/concrete-polishing.html): AGX Polish (multi-step diamond-ground polished concrete in matte, low sheen, high sheen or high gloss) and AGX Seal (diamond grind and seal in matte or gloss).
- [Commercial and industrial floors](https://aggrepoxy.com/services/industrial.html): urethane cement (AGX Thermal Shield), non-slip epoxy with silica sand (AGX Iron Tread), flexible polyurethane traffic coating (AGX Flex Guard), solid color epoxy, and flake systems. For warehouses, food plants, dealerships, commercial kitchens, parking structures and aircraft hangars. Night, weekend and phased scheduling.
- Surface preparation: diamond grinding, shot blasting, crack and joint repair, and removal of failing coatings and tile.

## Frequently asked questions

### General questions
Source: https://aggrepoxy.com/faq.html

**Do you offer free estimates?**
Yes. Every estimate is a free, no-obligation on-site walkthrough. We'll look at your slab, talk through your goals, and can usually give you a firm number before we leave.

**How much does a concrete coating cost?**
Cost depends on square footage, the current condition of your slab, and which system you choose (flake, quartz, solid color, or metallic). There's no accurate way to quote a floor sight-unseen, which is why the walkthrough is free.

**How long does installation take?**
Most residential garages are installed in 1 day, from diamond grinding to the final topcoat. Larger industrial and commercial floors are scoped individually based on square footage and your operating schedule.

**How long before I can use the floor?**
Most floors are ready for light foot traffic in about 24 hours and full vehicle traffic in 48 hours. Cure times can vary slightly depending on temperature and humidity. We'll give you a care guide after install to make sure your investment is protected.

**Do you warranty against chipping and peeling?**
Yes. Every install is backed by our 10-year limited warranty. If an issue ever stems from our product or workmanship, our team will step in and make it right.

**Does the warranty cover cracking?**
Our warranty covers our product and workmanship. Cracking caused by slab movement or settling that's already present, or that happens after installation, isn't something a surface coating can prevent, but we inspect your slab during the estimate and flag any concerns up front.

**Will my floor be slippery when wet?**
No. Every system we install includes a texture or slip-resistant additive engineered into the topcoat, so you get a durable, easy-to-clean finish without sacrificing traction.

**Can you install in the winter?**
Yes. Our high-solids resins are engineered for performance in extreme conditions, including Chicagoland's freeze-thaw winters, so we install year-round in both of our service regions.

**Do I need to clear out the space beforehand?**
Yes, the floor needs to be clear of vehicles, storage, and any parked items before we arrive. We'll send you a simple prep checklist as soon as your job is scheduled.

**Can I customize my floor?**
Yes. Your floor doesn't have to look like everyone else's. We can customize your blend colors and flake sizes, or add a custom logo or design that showcases your lifestyle or hobbies.

**Can it go over failing epoxy or old concrete?**
Yes. We inspect your slab, repair cracks and uneven spots, check for moisture, and remove any old or failing coating. That prep gives the new system a strong bond, so your floor lasts.

**Will there be a lot of dust or odor during installation?**
Our prep work is done with diamond grinders paired with HEPA-filter vacuums to keep dust contained, and our coatings are low-odor. We ventilate the space properly throughout application and cure.

**Do I need to be home during installation?**
Not necessarily, as long as our crew has access to the space. We're happy to coordinate access ahead of time so you don't have to take the day off.

**How do I clean and maintain the floor?**
Day to day, a dust mop or broom is all it needs. For a deeper clean, an occasional mop with mild soap and warm water keeps it looking new. Avoid harsh solvents or acid-based cleaners, they aren't necessary and can dull the finish over time.

**What if I have questions after installation?**
Our team stays available after the job is done. If something doesn't look or feel right, reach out and we'll make it right, that's what our 10-year limited warranty is there for.

**Do you serve both LA and Chicago?**
Yes. We install across Los Angeles, Orange County, and the Inland Empire, as well as the greater Chicago metro area. Reach out and let us know where you're located.


### Residential: Southern California
Source: https://aggrepoxy.com/los-angeles.html

**How long does the floor take to cure after install?**
Most floors are ready for light foot traffic in about 24 hours and full vehicle traffic in 48 hours. Cure times can vary slightly depending on temperature and humidity. We'll give you a care guide after install to make sure your investment is protected.

**Will hot tires lift the coating?**
No. Our topcoat is engineered to resist hot tire pickup, the peeling you often see with DIY epoxy kits.

**Is the floor slippery when wet?**
We add texture and full flake to improve traction, making the floor safer than bare concrete, even when wet.

**Will it fade or yellow in the sun?**
No. The topcoat is UV stable, so it won't yellow or fade, even on patios, driveways, and garages with the door open all day.

**Can you remove a failing coating or tile?**
Yes. We see this a lot: homeowners with peeling coatings from a DIY installation. We'll remove the old coating or tile so your new floor gets a long-lasting bond to the concrete slab.

**Do you offer financing?**
Yes. Financing is available on our estimate through Acorn Finance, making it easy to get approved quickly.


### Garage, driveway and patio coatings
Source: https://aggrepoxy.com/services/garage-floors.html

**How long does an estimate take?**
About 20 minutes. We measure the space, check the condition of your concrete, and show you flake and quartz samples, then put together your quote. We never quote over the phone, because every slab is different.

**Will it be slippery?**
No. Flake leaves a light texture underfoot, and quartz adds even more grip. For patios, pool decks, stairs, and anywhere that gets wet, we'll recommend the right texture for your space.

**Do I need to clear the space?**
Yes. The area must be completely empty before we arrive on install day: cars, shelving, storage, everything. We don't move items, so plan ahead and we'll be ready to start the moment we pull up.

**Will it yellow over time?**
No. Our polyaspartic topcoat is UV stable, so it won't amber or yellow in the sun, even with the garage door open all day. That's the main reason we use it instead of an epoxy topcoat.


### Polished and sealed concrete
Source: https://aggrepoxy.com/services/concrete-polishing.html

**What's the difference between sealed and polished concrete?**
Both start with a diamond grind. Sealed concrete is finished with a protective sealer in matte or gloss. Polished concrete goes through multiple finer diamond passes until the concrete itself shines. Polished costs more, but lasts longer and needs less upkeep.

**Is polished concrete slippery?**
When dry, it's no more slippery than most smooth floors. Like tile or stone, it can get slick when wet, so for wet areas we'll recommend a lower sheen or an anti-slip treatment.

**How long does it last?**
Polished concrete can last decades with basic care, because the finish is the slab itself. Sealed floors last for years and can be resealed when they start to show wear.

**Can my existing slab be polished?**
Most can. Cracks, patches, and old coatings can affect the final look, so we check your slab at the free estimate and tell you exactly what to expect.

**How do I maintain it?**
Dust mop regularly and damp mop with a pH-neutral cleaner. No waxing or stripping needed.


### Commercial and industrial floors
Source: https://aggrepoxy.com/services/industrial.html

**Can you work around our operating hours?**
Yes. We schedule nights, weekends, and holiday shutdowns, and can phase the work so the rest of your facility keeps running.

**How soon can we return to service?**
It depends on the system, the floor temperature, and the traffic you run. Your proposal spells out exact return times for foot, vehicle, and forklift traffic.

**Which system is right for our facility?**
It comes down to what the floor sees every day: heat, chemicals, washdowns, forklifts, or customers. We recommend a system after assessing your slab and operation.

**How do you prepare the concrete?**
We remove old tile and coatings, shot blast or diamond grind to open the slab, repair cracks and joints, and check for moisture. Prep is where most commercial floors fail, so we never skip it.

**Can you remove our existing tile or coating?**
Yes. Tile removal and coating removal are part of our prep, so the new system bonds directly to sound concrete.


### Chicago commercial projects
Source: https://aggrepoxy.com/chi.html

**Can you install to our project spec?**
Yes. Share the spec or plans when Jim follows up. We'll confirm the system, match it, or recommend an approved equal if something better fits the conditions.

**How do we get a bid?**
Use the bid form or call Jim directly. Jim will follow up to collect plans and specs, schedule a walkthrough, and get you a written proposal.

**Can you work around other trades and our schedule?**
Yes. We coordinate with your schedule and other trades, and can phase the work or install on nights and weekends to keep the project moving.

**What areas do you serve?**
Chicago and the surrounding Chicagoland suburbs. Projects just outside the area? Reach out and we'll let you know.
